name: townsend-plugins
description: Townsend AI Studio plugins for Claude Code and Cowork: product-flow (stage-by-stage product management), pm-growth-coach (PM self-development), prompt-coach (prompt guardrails and answer verification), custody-check (the eleven custody questions for AI-built apps, read-only), build-decisions (every place found where an AI-built app decides access, prices, paid status and money rounding, and how the app is built, read-only; replaces decision-census, kept as a pointer), and spell-it-out (technical yes/no stops explained in plain English before you answer).

plugins.name: product-flow
plugins.description: Stage-by-stage product management workflow: discovery, positioning, strategy, prioritization, PRD, delivery, launch, and measurement — with framework menus, fill-in templates with quality bars, evidence rules, a shared project workspace, and a built-in critique gate.

plugins.name: pm-growth-coach
plugins.description: A self-development coach for product managers: competency baseline against a behavioral rubric, growth plan with weekly deliberate-practice reps, and evidence-based progress tracking using your real work artifacts.

plugins.name: prompt-coach
plugins.description: Uplevel prompts with the right guardrails, verify AI answers before they ship, teach staff to prompt better, and keep the guidance current via a human-approved refresh cycle.

plugins.name: custody-check
plugins.description: Run the eleven gut-check questions from 'It Said It Was Fine' on your own AI-built app, read-only, and get a plain report: what is broken, what it means for you, and what your code can't tell. Works in Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: build-decisions
plugins.description: Find where your AI-built app decides who can see a record, what something costs, whether someone has paid, and how money rounds, how the app is built, and where it saves whether someone has paid, then get a short plain-English analysis of each decision made in more than one place and what it means for you. Read-only; a review, not an audit.

plugins.name: decision-census
plugins.description: Decision Census is now Build Decisions. This pointer tells you how to install build-decisions and remove this plugin. It runs nothing.

plugins.name: spell-it-out
plugins.description: When Claude stops to ask you a technical yes/no or choice, it spells it out first: the ask, where things stand, what each answer changes, whether you can undo it, its pick, the safe answer if you're not sure, and a one-line TL;DR. For people who build with AI but don't read code.
